runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 20:20 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities, Facebook public indexing and Praca za rohom supplementary discovery. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, skill, economics and trust gates. The closest fresh non-Profesia candidate was Upwork Beginning-friendly Remote Task - Virtual Assistant Needed: Worldwide, 1500 USD fixed, entry level, Slovak listed among accepted language pairs, posted about 5 hours before verification. It remains verification-only because the client account was created 10.9.2026, has no visible spend/hire history, 20-50 proposals and the scope/payment structure is unusually generic. LinkedIn produced current Bratislava/remote support inventory, but SupportYourApp requires fluent/C1 English and technical infrastructure/VPS scope, while Wolt requires English B2 and shifts. Facebook public indexing produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Freelance account-age trust floor
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Before promoting unusually attractive remote freelance offers, combine client account age, verified spend, prior hires, payment history and proposal activity into a trust floor. New accounts with no history should remain verification-only even when pay and location look strong; this reduces scam/abandonment risk without suppressing established clients.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Generic-scope payment anomaly detector
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Flag listings whose compensation is high relative to a vague beginner-level scope such as simple data entry/basic admin. Require stronger client-history and deliverable evidence before promotion. This saves application time and improves trust calibration for freelance discovery.
